Mutter-Beethoven-Haus
points_of_interest.description:
Maria Magdalena Keverich was born in this house in 1746. Open on Sundays, except for special group bookings 
Contact: Mittelrhein Museum, Koblenz Tel. 0261 129 250

points_of_interest.name: Rhein-Museum Koblenz
points_of_interest.description: Located down by the Rhine along the cycle route, visitors can discover and experience everything about the turbulent history of the Rhine across more than 1,400 m² of exhibition space. The exhibits range from Neanderthals to remarkable works from the Rhine Romanticism period; Open: 10:00–17:00 Admission €7.00

points_of_interest.name: Schloss Sayn
points_of_interest.description: Castle Park, butterfly garden, European History Exhibition; admission €13.00 Opening hours: daily 10:00–18:00 Just three kilometres from the banks of the Rhine.
